title: "DataCite Corpus - Time Series Correlations"

date: "2026-10-09"
output: pdf_document

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(parallel)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(zoo)

dat <- read_csv("merged.csv")
rw <- data.frame(read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashnryn/article-retractions/refs/heads/main/retraction-watch/retraction_watch.csv",
  na.strings = c("", "unavailable"))) |> 
  filter(!is.na(OriginalPaperDOI)) |>
  filter(!OriginalPaperDOI %in% dat$data.citation.id)
```

Plot of total number of retractions by publication month, with rolling average in red.

```{r datavis}
dat <- dat |> mutate(pub.monthyear = mdy_hm(pub.date) %>% as.yearmon("%Y-%m"))
rw <- rw |> mutate(pub.monthyear = mdy_hm(OriginalPaperDate) %>% as.yearmon("%Y-%m"))

# full dataset
dat |>
  distinct(data.citation.id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(pub.monthyear) |> 
  mutate(avg = cummean(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = n)) +
    geom_point(pch = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = avg), 
              size = 0.75, alpha = 0.4, colour = "red") +
    labs(x = "Publication Month", y = "Count") +
    theme_linedraw()

# Subset - 2020-25 only
dat |>
  distinct(data.citation.id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(pub.year >= 2020) |>
  count(pub.monthyear) |> 
  mutate(avg = cummean(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = n)) +
    geom_point(pch = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = avg), 
              size = 0.75, alpha = 0.4, colour = "red") +
    labs(x = "Publication Month", y = "Count") +
    theme_linedraw()

# Compare to full RW dataset
rw |> distinct(OriginalPaperDOI, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(pub.monthyear) |>
  mutate(avg = cummean(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = n)) +
    geom_point(pch = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = avg),
              size = 0.75, alpha = 0.4, colour = "red") +
    labs(x = "Publication Month", y = "Count") +
    theme_linedraw()

rw |> distinct(OriginalPaperDOI, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(pub.monthyear) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = n)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_line(aes(x = pub.monthyear, y = n), 
              data = dat %>% 
                distinct(data.citation.id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
                count(pub.monthyear),
              colour = "blue") +
    labs(x = "Publication Month", y = "Count") +
    theme_linedraw()
```

Notable - the major spike in RW entries around 2010-11 is not mirrored in the growth of the 'merged' dataset

```{r data-wrangle}
## For merged RW/DataCite data
aggdata <- dat |> 
  distinct(data.citation.id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(pub.monthyear)

monthyears = c()
for (yr in seq(min(dat$pub.year), max(dat$pub.year), by = 1)) {
  monthyears <- monthyears |> append(
    paste0("01", tolower(month.abb), yr) %>% 
      as.Date(format = "%d%b%Y") %>%
      as.yearmon()
    )
}

monthyears <- data.frame(monthyear = monthyears, n = c(0))[-c(1:3),]
aggdata <- monthyears |> 
  full_join(aggdata, by = join_by(monthyear == pub.monthyear))

aggdata <- aggdata |> 
  mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n.y), n.x, n.y)) |>
  select(monthyear, n)

tsdat <- ts(
  data = aggdata$n,
  start = c(1997, 4),
  end = c(2021, 12),
  frequency = 12
)

tsdat

## For Retraction Watch only
aggrw <- rw |>
  distinct(OriginalPaperDOI, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(pub.monthyear)

monthyears = c()
for (yr in seq(min(rw$OriginalPaperDate %>% mdy_hm() %>% year()), 
               max(rw$OriginalPaperDate %>% mdy_hm() %>% year()), 
               by = 1)) {
  monthyears <- monthyears |> append(
    paste0("01", tolower(month.abb), yr) %>% 
      as.Date(format = "%d%b%Y") %>%
      as.yearmon()
    )
}

monthyears <- data.frame(monthyear = unlist(monthyears), n = c(0))
aggrw <- monthyears |> 
  full_join(aggrw, by = join_by(monthyear == pub.monthyear))

aggrw <- aggrw |> 
  mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n.y), n.x, n.y)) |>
  select(monthyear, n)

tsrw <- ts(
  data = aggrw$n,
  start = c(1940, 1),
  end = c(2025, 12),
  frequency = 12
)

rm(monthyears)
```

```{r correlation}
# Autocorrelation
acf(tsdat)
acf(tsrw)

# Partial autocorrelation
pacf(tsdat)
pacf(tsrw)

# Cross-correlation
ccf(tsdat, tsrw)

# Restrict tsrw to April 1997-Dec 2024
tsrw_limit <- ts(data = aggrw$n[c(688:1020)],
                 start = c(1997, 4),
                 end = c(2024, 12),
                 frequency = 12)
ccf(tsdat, tsrw_limit)

# Regression diagnostics
lm(n ~ monthyear, data = aggrw) %>% plot()
lm(n ~ monthyear, data = aggdata) %>% plot()

lm(n ~ monthyear, data = aggdata)
lm(n ~ monthyear, data = aggrw)

# Decomposition
tsrw_decomp <- decompose(tsrw)
tsdat_decomp <- decompose(tsdat)

plot(tsrw_decomp)
plot(tsdat_decomp)
```
